content.title: How to watch 2026 Masters live: Round 4 TV coverage, channel and streaming guide for Sunday
content.text: Getty Images AUGUSTA, Ga. -- The 2026 Masters has arrived at its final stanza, and the second nine is hot with some of the best golfers in the world jockeying for position at the country's best course. For one, there is a green jacket waiting on the other side (along with the winner's share of the 2026 Masters purse, which stands at $22.5 million with a variety of prize money payouts) at Augusta National Golf Club.While only one will be lucky enough to achieve the green jacket, a stacked 2026 Masters leaderboard is providing an incredible run to the finish. Despite falling off during Moving Day, Rory McIlroy has moved back into the solo lead on the second nine Sunday with significant names like Justin Rose, Cameron Young and Scottie Scheffler all firmly in pursuit. Should McIlroy prevail, he will become the first golfer to win back-to-back green jackets since Tiger Woods (2001-02), despite coughing up a Masters-record six-shot advantage on Saturday.There is so much to follow on Sunday that it can be overwhelming at times. No worries: We have you covered. CBS Sports is offering live coverage of the 2026 Masters from start to finish with our myriad of Masters Live streaming options. Hit the links below to tune into the Featured Groups channel and watch complete rounds from some of the best golfers in the game, spend your day surveying Amen Corner or view all the action at Holes 15 & 16. Masters TV coverage does not begin until later in the day, so this is the absolute best place to watch the Masters live on Sunday.Enjoy expanded broadcast coverage from CBS Sports and Paramount+ on Sunday. Check out the complete 2026 Masters TV schedule and coverage guide so you do not miss a single moment from this tradition unlike any other.
